skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Mastery of body movement and agility.

skills.name: Awareness
skills.description: Heightened perception and vigilance.

skills.name: Bartering
skills.description: The art of negotiation and vigilance.

skills.name: Beast Lore
skills.description: Skill in understanding and interacting with creatures.

skills.name: Bluffing
skills.description: Deceptive communication and misdirection.

skills.name: Bushcraft
skills.description: Wilderness survival skills.

skills.name: Crafting
skills.description: The ability to repair, create, and modify items.

skills.name: Evade
skills.description: Quick reflexes and dodging capabilities.

skills.name: Healing
skills.description: Knowledge of medicinal arts and first aid.

skills.name: Hunting and Fishing
skills.description: Expertise in procuring sustenance from the wild.

skills.name: Languages
skills.description: Proficiency in additional languages.

skills.name: Myths and Legends
skills.description: Knowledge of folklore, mythology, and historycal legends.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Skill in entertaining and captivating an audience.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: The ability to influence and sway others.

skills.name: Riding
skills.description: Proficiency in mounted travel.

skills.name: Seamanship
skills.description: Proficiency in the maritime arts.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Dexterity and finesse in manual trickery.

skills.name: Sneaking
skills.description: Stealth and subtlety in movement.

skills.name: Spot Hidden
skills.description: The ability to notice concealed details and hidden objects.

skills.name: Swimming
skills.description: Proficiency in aquatic movement.

skills.name: Axes
skills.description: Axes of all kinds, also when thrown.

skills.name: Bows
skills.description: Any bow. Crossbows have their own skill.

skills.name: Brawling
skills.description: Fighting bare-handed, with feet, teeth, or claws too.

skills.name: Crossbows
skills.description: Every kind of crossbow.

skills.name: Hammers
skills.description: Blunt weapons, warhammers, clubs, flails and maces.

skills.name: Knives
skills.description: Knives and daggers, in hand or thrown.

skills.name: Slings
skills.description: Loosing stones from a sling.

skills.name: Spears
skills.description: Spears, lances, halberds and tridents, also when thrown.

skills.name: Staves
skills.description: Staff fighting.

skills.name: Swords
skills.description: Every kind of sword.

skills.name: Adaptive
skills.description: Substitute any skill you own for the one a roll calls for, if you can explain how it fits. The GM rules on the fit and errs on the side of yes.

skills.name: Hard To Catch
skills.description: Spend it while dodging to give the EVADE roll a boon.

skills.name: Unforgiving
skills.description: Activate when attacking a creature that has dealt you at least 1 point of damage at any time in the past. The attack roll gains a boon.

skills.name: Inner Peace
skills.description: During a stretch rest you may sink into a deep meditation. You recover an extra D6 HP and an extra D6 WP and shake off one more condition, but nothing can rouse you until the rest ends.

skills.name: Ill Tempered
skills.description: Activate (no action) before any skill roll to gain a boon on it. You also gain the Angry condition if you did not have it already. Not usable on INT rolls or INT-based skills.

skills.name: Webbed Feet
skills.description: SWIMMING rolls gain a boon, and water never slows you down, on the surface or below it.

skills.name: Hunting Instinct
skills.description: Mark one creature you can see or smell as your prey; in combat this takes an action. For a full day you can track the prey by scent. Attacks against it gain a boon for a further 1 WP, spent without an action.

skills.name: Resilient
skills.description: Activate for a boon on CON rolls to resist poison or disease (pages 52–53), or to make camp with no BUSHCRAFT roll (page 103). Raw food never makes you sick, at no WP cost.

skills.name: Body Slam
skills.description: An unarmed melee attack made with a boon that cannot be parried. It deals 2D6 bludgeoning damage with no damage bonus, and you may dash first. A humanoid of Normal size or smaller that is hit falls prone.

skills.name: Tough
skills.description: At zero HP, activate to rally at once (page 50) with no WIL roll and no need for another character to PERSUADE you. Meant for player characters and important NPCs.

skills.name: Nine Lives
skills.description: Spend 3 WP to activate for a boon on a death roll (page 50). Alternatively, after the ACROBATICS roll to soften a fall (page 53), spend up to 3 WP to remove one D6 of falling damage per WP.

skills.name: Leaping
skills.description: Activate to jump your full movement rating forward or half of it upward, with no ACROBATICS roll. If the jump ends next to an enemy, you may follow it with a melee attack made with a boon.

skills.name: Wings
skills.description: Fly at your walking speed for 1 WP each round.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.description: Activate for a boon on a SNEAKING roll.

skills.name: Raise Spirits
skills.description: As an action, sing or recite to remove one condition of your choice from an ally within 10 meters who can hear you. It does not work on yourself.

skills.name: Assassin
skills.description: Add D8 to the damage of a sneak attack.

skills.name: Backstabbing
skills.description: Melee attack against an enemy close to another player. Your sneak attack cannot be dodged or parried, have a boon and the number of dice rolled for the damage is increased by one.

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.description: Each other player character within earshot sheds one condition of their choice, right away.

skills.name: Berserker
skills.description: You gain the Angry condition and a boon to melee attacks, but can not parry or dodge. After the fight you become Exhausted.

skills.name: Catlike
skills.description: Each WP spent removes one D6 from falling damage.

skills.name: Companion
skills.description: Turn one animal (not a monster) into your companion. The animal can scout and also attack for a WP cost of 3.

skills.name: Contortionist
skills.description: Slip out of bonds or through a tight gap with no skill roll.

skills.name: Defensive
skills.description: Try to Parry an attack without using your action for the round.

skills.name: Deflect Arrow
skills.description: A melee weapon can parry arrows, bolts, and other ranged attacks.

skills.name: Disguise
skills.description: Pass yourself off as a specific other person, in face, voice, and manner.

skills.name: Double Slash
skills.description: One swing hits two enemies within 2 meters.

skills.name: Dragon Slayer
skills.description: Add D8 damage to an attack on a monster.

skills.name: Dual Wield
skills.description: Make a second attack with your off-hand weapon, with a bane.

skills.name: Eagle Eye
skills.description: For one stretch, make out people and objects up to 200 meters away, and shoot past your weapon's range with no bane.

skills.name: Fast Footwork
skills.description: Try to Dodge an attack without using your action for the round.

skills.name: Fast Healer
skills.description: A stretch rest restores an extra D6 HP.

skills.name: Fearless
skills.description: Fear never takes hold; no WIL roll is needed.

skills.name: Focused
skills.description: Maximum WP rises by 2 for good.

skills.name: Guardian
skills.description: Draw an enemy's attack onto yourself instead of a nearby ally.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: An AWARENESS roll tells you whether someone is lying, though not what about.

skills.name: Intuition
skills.description: Put one question to the GM and get a useful answer.

skills.name: Iron Fist
skills.description: Unarmed attacks deal 2D6 damage.

skills.name: Iron Grip
skills.description: Grappling BRAWLING rolls gain a boon.

skills.name: Lightning Fast
skills.description: Draw two initiative cards and keep the one you prefer.

skills.name: Lone Wolf
skills.description: Take a shift rest without a roll for BUSHCRAFT.

skills.name: Magic Talent
skills.description: Learn one more school of magic.

skills.name: Massive Blow
skills.description: A two-handed melee weapon strike adds D* damage, but you cannot move that round.

skills.name: Master Blacksmith
skills.description: Sharpen weapons and craft metal weapons and armor.

skills.name: Master Carpenter
skills.description: Do D12 damage to objects and craft wood weapons and tools.

skills.name: Master Chef
skills.description: Cooking always succeeds, with no BUSHCRAFT roll.

skills.name: Master SpellCaster
skills.description: Cast two spells with one action, as long as they are different spells.

skills.name: Master Tanner
skills.description: Craft leather armor from animals and monsters.

skills.name: Master Hunter
skills.description: At a fork in the road, learn which way the most dangerous enemies lie.

skills.name: Musician
skills.description: Allies within 10 meters gain a boon on every roll, or enemies in that range take a bane, for one turn.

skills.name: Pathfinder
skills.description: BUSHCRAFT rolls to find your way in the wild gain a boon.

skills.name: Quartermaster
skills.description: Making camp on a journey always succeeds.

skills.name: Robust
skills.description: Maximum HP rises by 2.

skills.name: Sea Legs
skills.description: You are safe from all negative effects of being in water for one round, including the risk of drowning.

skills.name: Shield Block
skills.description: Shield parries gain a boon, and a shield can parry a monster's physical attacks that no weapon could, area effects excepted.

skills.name: Throwing Arm
skills.description: Throw a melee weapon at an enemy within your STR meters. It must be a onehanded weapon.

skills.name: Treasure Hunter
skills.description: At a fork in the road, learn which way the richest treasure lies.

skills.name: Twin Shot
skills.description: Loose two arrows from a bow, not a crossbow, with one attack roll made with a bane.

skills.name: Veteran
skills.description: Keep last round's initiative card.

skills.name: Weasel
skills.description: If attacked and another player is within 2 meters, you can let the attack hit that player instead of you.
